command.acceptAll: Pre-edit Review: Arm Accept All (auto-accept window)
command.rejectAll: Pre-edit Review: Reject All Pending Reviews
config.stateDir: Directory that contains the Host plugin's Unix socket (ipc.sock) and authentication token (token). Must match the Host plugin's stateDir.
config.autoConnect: Connect to the Host plugin automatically when VS Code starts.
config.autoAccept: Allow the dpr.acceptAll command to arm a 5-minute auto-accept window. When enabled, changes arriving while armed are committed without asking.
config.messageDurationMs: How long transient DeepSeek Pre-edit Review messages stay in the status bar (1000-30000 ms). The default is 5000 ms. VS Code native notifications have a fixed lifetime that extensions cannot change; set dpr.useNativeNotifications to use them instead.
config.useNativeNotifications: Show transient review messages as native VS Code notifications instead of the 5-second status-bar message. Native notification lifetime is controlled by VS Code, not by this extension.
